/* ===== v6.8 POLISH PACK ===== */ :root{ --polish-accent:#8b7cff;--polish-cyan:#39d9ff;--polish-green:#39d9ff; --polish-panel:rgba(13,19,33,.78);--polish-border:rgba(151,170,220,.16); } html{scroll-behavior:smooth} body{overflow-x:hidden} .app{min-height:100vh} .side{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;z-index:30} .nav{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis} .top{position:sticky!important;z-index:25!important} .top .search{min-width:180px} .content{animation:pageIn .28s ease both} @keyframes pageIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}} .card,.hero,.item,.btn,.nav,input,select,textarea{will-change:transform} .card .actions{position:relative;z-index:2} .btn:focus-visible,.nav:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid rgba(139,124,255,.75)!important;outline-offset:2px!important; } .section-kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8190ad;margin-bottom:7px} .live-dot{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--polish-green);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--polish-green);margin-right:7px} .status-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--polish-border);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);font-size:11px;color:#b7c3da} .kpi-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:0 0 18px} .kpi{padding:14px 15px;border:1px solid var(--polish-border);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(8,13,24,.55)} .kpi small{display:block;color:#8190a9;margin-bottom:5px}.kpi strong{font-size:20px} .command-palette{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(2,5,12,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);z-index:100;display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding-top:12vh} .command-palette.open{display:flex} .command-box{width:min(620px,calc(100% - 28px));background:#0d1424;border:1px solid rgba(139,124,255,.3);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 30px 100px #000b;overflow:hidden} .command-box input{width:100%;padding:16px 18px;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--polish-border)!important;border-radius:0!important;font-size:16px} .command-results{max-height:420px;overflow:auto;padding:8px} .command-result{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;border-radius:10px;color:#cbd5e8;cursor:pointer} .command-result:hover{background:rgba(139,124,255,.12);color:#fff} .cmd-key{margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;color:#71809b;border:1px solid var(--polish-border);padding:3px 6px;border-radius:6px} .sidebar-collapsed .side{width:76px!important} .sidebar-collapsed .brand{font-size:0} .sidebar-collapsed .brand:after{display:none} .sidebar-collapsed .nav{font-size:0;text-align:center} .sidebar-collapsed .nav:first-letter{font-size:17px} .sidebar-collapsed .nav:after{display:none} .sidebar-collapsed .main{min-width:0} .mobile-menu{display:none} @media(max-width:900px){.kpi-strip{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}} @media(max-width:700px){.kpi-strip{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mobile-menu{display:inline-flex}.side{position:fixed;left:0;transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .2s ease}.mobile-open .side{transform:none}.mobile-open:after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0008;z-index:20}} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.content{animation:none}}
